entities.summary: Suwon Gymnasium is an indoor sporting arena located in Suwon, South Korea. Built in 1984 to host handball events at the 1988 Summer Olympics, the gymnasium has a capacity of 5,145 spectators. At the 2014 Asian Games, the gymnasium hosted handball and table tennis matches. In 2021, the KT Sonicboom men's basketball team relocated from Busan to Suwon. Today, Suwon Gymnasium is part of the Suwon Sports Complex.
